dataset: VIIRS 375 m Thermal Anomalies and Fires (Suomi NPP and NOAA-20), via NASA GIBS WMS
method: Each day's PNG (UTC date) is rasterised to the 20x20 grid by counting opaque detection pixels per cell (max of the two satellites). A cell is a fire cell on a day if it has >= 20 pixels and >= 3x its maximum over the pre-event baseline days, which masks persistent industrial heat sources. eventDay is the first such day counted from the mission start, 0 = 2025-01-08; cells first detected on 2025-01-07 are also day 0.
